component.name: PrintCraft
component.summary: Make greeting cards, signs, banners and labels, then print them

description.p: PrintCraft is a friendly home-publishing app for greeting cards, signs, banners, labels, certificates, envelopes and more. It has a familiar layout with a tool panel, rulers and the page in the middle, light and dark looks, text effects, a photo editor, and printing that lays out folded cards, banners and label sheets for you.
